Chapter 6627: Fierce Longevity Dao

Chapter 6627: Fierce Longevity Dao

She had no intention of looking down on Light God. However, how could he possibly stop her?

“I will do my best to uphold my responsibility.” He took a deep breath and said firmly.

He didn’t roar or burst forth with an overwhelming aura. He spoke simply and revealed his resolution. He was unswayed despite being an egg thrown against a rock.

“What a hero, a man of his word.” A primal ancestor whispered.

Those who disagreed with his golden reputation changed their mind.

“So be it.” Staff Ancestor didn’t waste words and reached for Time Stopper.

Her fair hand with a starry light attracted everyone’s attention, capable of grasping stars without activating merit laws.

Spectators had no time to appreciate its beauty, only its dominant authority. Everyone thought she could grasp Heaven World and send it flying. They feared for their lives, realizing the insurmountable gap.

Running was futile for Light God. He roared and said: “The light will never die!”

He activated all of his power, summoning his fate palaces and dazzling true fate.

“Boom!” His light flowed across space and time, turning into a river. He leaped into it, wanting to create a temporal gap with Staff Ancestor.

It became a matter of time, not distance. Spectators realized they had underestimated Light God. Perhaps he could escape the initial blow.

However, she didn’t switch her stance and still moved forward, crushing the radiant river of time. The formidable technique stood no chance against her mere movement, once again displaying the power gap between the two realms.

“Fierce Longevity Dao!” He summoned a saber and slashed during the temporal river’s collapse.

“An immortal artifact!” Spectators shouted in astonishment.

His weapon was one of the three ancient immortal artifacts, Mountaincutter. This was the primary evidence of his being the successor to the Three Immortals.

Thus, although he hadn’t met them, he still inherited their legacy and could be considered a direct disciple.

“Clank!” The slash didn’t devastate space as expected. It split space in two, and life force oozed out of the chasm. Life prolonged everything, resulting in limitless potential.

Even an ant could live for millions of years; a mortal had a good chance of becoming immortal. Therefore, the end of the slash had the image of an immortal paradise.

“Boom!” The paradise of infinity blocked Staff Ancestor’s reach.

“Rumble!” As her hand approached, it created ripples like a fish going against the current. Her speed slowed down dramatically.
